General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Cushion that goes below the Soft Top Garnish piece.
The Soft Top Garnish piece is what attaches to the top of the Windshield Frame and holds the front edge of the Soft Top in place.
This Cushion goes under that Garnish.
Has a Self Adhesive Backing
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Soft Top Garnish Cushion
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
